headline: Thursday and Friday Pressers
deck: Rayan Cherki a doubt for Manchester City; Isak and Gakpo ruled out for Liverpool
body:
Rayan Cherki is a doubt for Manchester City, with no complaint given.

Enzo Maresca rated him one of the best players in Europe when he is in the right position, and said he and Phil Foden can play together depending on the opposition.

teamNews.line: Onana, Aaron Wan-Bissaka and Ruggeri remain out, and others in pain after Wednesday's match await Friday afternoon's session.

quote.text: Still being some players clearly out like Onana, Aaron Wan-Bissaka and Ruggeri. Other players we will see how they are after the match we played on Wednesday.

teamNews.line: Anthony Elanga awaits an MRI, and William Osula twisted an ankle and is too early to call for Monday.

quote.text: Amar will be also not able to play on Saturday.

teamNews.line: Nathan Collins and Matty Jensen are closer to a return, and Jannik has trained again after a disrupted week.

men.name: Antoni Milambo
men.note: back from a knee injury; not yet involved

men.name: Josh Dasilva
men.note: back from a hamstring injury; not yet involved

quote.text: Antoni and Josh definitely won’t be involved tomorrow.

teamNews.line: Cristhian Mosquera and Ben White are available, and Christos Tzolis is back in training.

men.name: Noni Madueke
men.note: ankle

quote.text: Probably [he will be out until after the international break].

teamNews.line: Moisés Caicedo is fit, Pep Chavarría returns to the squad and Cole Palmer is banned.

men.name: Pep Chavarría
men.note: back from a muscle injury; back in the squad

men.name: Maxence Lacroix
men.note: a few weeks; not ready before the international break

men.name: Moisés Caicedo
men.note: trained well; ready to go

quote.text: Max picked up an injury and we expect that he is not going to be ready before the international break. So, he will be a few weeks out.

teamNews.line: Alex Isak has a small thigh injury and Cody Gakpo an ankle injury, neither expected to be long term, while Jeremy Jacquet is fit.

quote.text: Alex Isak and Cody Gakpo will not play the game. They are not ready.

teamNews.line: Erling Haaland is fit after a few days off, Phil Foden is available, and Antoine Semenyo remains the one absentee.

men.name: Rayan Cherki
men.note: can play alongside Foden, depending on opposition

quote.text: Still a doubt. For sure, Erling is the only one 100% available, and the other three we need to wait for today’s session.

teamNews.line: Pedro Porro is back, Dejan Kulusevski travels with the squad, and Bergvall and Mudryk remain out.

men.name: James Maddison
men.note: back from a groin injury; missed three or four days of training

men.name: Destiny Udogie
men.note: back from a knee injury

men.name: Tosin
men.note: calf

quote.text: Porro, Tonali, Maddison, all are available to play.

teamNews.line: Sasa Lukic misses the weekend with a groin injury, held back to be fully fit for the Hull match.

quote.text: No, he’s not going to make it. Sasa will be out tomorrow.

teamNews.line: Mykolenko has a chance, Christian Norgaard is not yet ready to start and Merlin Röhl is hoped to be ready at the end of the international break.

men.name: Jarrad Branthwaite
men.note: concussion; expected to have recovered

quote.text: Jarrad should have recovered from his concussion and also the timescale which we had to abide by.

teamNews.line: Hugo has a groin problem and is uncertain for Saturday, with everyone else available.

quote.text: We have a small problem with Hugo – his groin.

teamNews.line: Patrick Dorgu faces a number of weeks out, and Kobbie has returned to training.

men.name: Luke Shaw
men.note: short term; assessed at the weekend

men.name: Marcus Rashford
men.note: hip; some training done

men.name: Patrick Dorgu
men.note: probably a number of weeks; hamstring

men.name: Manuel Ugarte
men.note: knee

men.name: Benjamin Sesko
men.note: calf; further away, still undergoing checks

quote.text: Ben is further away, with the issue he has got. He won’t be ready.

teamNews.line: Yankuba Minteh and Mats Wieffer returned in Wednesday's match, and Luka Vuskovic is an option.

men.name: Stefanos Tzimas
men.note: back from a knee injury; back on the training pitch

men.name: Charalampos Kostoulas
men.note: rested Wednesday; expected to be an option for Saturday

quote.text: Regarding Pascal Struijk, he won’t be an option for the weekend, but we are quite convinced that he will be back afterwards.

teamNews.line: Eli Junior Kroupi is planned to return to the squad, Veljko is match-fit with the under-21s, and Alex Toth faces some weeks out with a muscle injury.

men.name: Alex Scott
men.note: back from a tendon injury; rehab ahead of schedule

quote.text: Brooksy is fully in team training.

teamNews.line: Dominic Calvert-Lewin and Noah Okafor trained normally and appear fully available.

men.name: Anton Stach
men.note: foot; still painful

men.name: Joe Rodon
men.note: back from a hamstring injury; part-integrated in team training, too soon for the weekend

men.name: Nico Elvedi
men.note: back in training

men.name: Daniel James
men.note: back from a back injury that cost him the Arsenal match

quote.text: Anton Stach is struggling still a bit with his foot injury. So, let’s see.

teamNews.line: Morgan Gibbs-White is a doubt with a minor muscle injury, and Nikola Milenkovic misses out with a bone bruise.

men.name: Neco Williams
men.note: back from an elbow injury; trained all week

men.name: Dan Ndoye
men.note: must train Friday without risk; expected fit for City

quote.text: Savona and Igor are still out. Nicolás Domínguez is progressing very well. He will train for the first time tomorrow with the team.

teamNews.line: Bobby Thomas has a small calf problem and is uncertain for the weekend, while Milan and Kaine are back in training.

quote.text: Haji won’t be back until November.

teamNews.line: Jorgen Strand Larsen joins group training on Thursday, Quinten Timber returns on Friday and Henderson's return is still being evaluated.

quote.text: He’s ready to play, and we managed him yesterday, because he played two times 60 [minutes] in seven days, and normally he has to play only two times 30 [minutes].

teamNews.line: Brian Brobbey and Habib are close to full availability, and Isidor should be available.

men.name: Nordi Mukiele
men.note: throat; minor and short term

quote.text: It’s a shame for Ballard because he was in a good place and he will be sidelined for a few weeks.

teamNews.line: Lewie Coyle has a minor hamstring issue but has trained, and Morita is due back after the first week of the international break.

men.name: Nobel Mendy
men.note: back from a groin injury; back in training

men.name: Oli McBurnie
men.note: ribs

men.name: Jack Butland
men.note: back from a shoulder injury; training with the group, decision Friday

quote.text: Jack is in training sessions with the group, which is excellent news.
